headline: Amending a city grant agreement with Harbor Homes, Inc. to allow housing for non-veterans and their families.
summary: Resolution R-26-080 asks the City of Nashua to change Section 7 of a 2006 grant agreement with Harbor Homes, Inc. Eight officials, including Mayor Jim Donchess, endorsed it.
items: Resolution R-26-080: amend Section 7 of the Economic Development Initiative and Community Development Block Grant agreement with Harbor Homes, Inc. to allow transitional and permanent housing for non-veterans and their families
